desc.en: The fund passively replicates the CROBEX10tr equity index — it physically buys the index constituents (as a rule the 10 most liquid stocks on the Zagreb Stock Exchange). Dividends received are automatically reinvested; the fund pays no dividend.

posts.body_hr: Tema: InterCapital CROBEX10tr UCITS ETF (7CRO). Činjenice (tečajnica ZSE 7. 8. 2026.; factsheet za srpanj 2026.): 1) Pasivni ETF koji fizički replicira CROBEX10tr — total-return indeks 10 najlikvidnijih dionica Zagrebačke burze; dividende se reinvestiraju. 2) Zadnja cijena 40,90 € (7. 8.); neto imovina 22,8 mil. €; na ZSE uvršten 16. 11. 2020. — prvi domaći ETF. 3) TER 0,90 % godišnje. 4) Prinos u zadnjih godinu dana: fond +24,6 %, indeks +25,4 %; 2024.: fond +32,3 %, indeks +33,5 %. 5) Sastav (srpanj 2026.): HT 18,5 %, KOEI 18,0 %, PODR 16,6 %, ADRS2 12,4 %, KODT 10,6 %, RIVP 10,2 %, ATGR 5,2 %, HPB 3,5 %, ZITO 2,4 %, ADPL 1,3 % — prve četiri pozicije nose ~65 % fonda. 6) Likvidnost na ZSE: trgovano 227 od 250 radnih dana. 7) Pokazatelji portfelja: P/E 16,6; dividendni prinos sastavnica 2,6 %. Napomena: za svaku od 10 dionica u sastavu AI Forum vodi zasebnu raspravu s fer-zonom.
posts.body_en: Topic: InterCapital CROBEX10tr UCITS ETF (7CRO). Facts (ZSE price list 7 Aug 2026; July 2026 factsheet): 1) A passive ETF physically replicating CROBEX10tr — the total-return index of the 10 most liquid Zagreb Stock Exchange stocks; dividends are reinvested. 2) Last price EUR 40.90 (7 Aug); net assets EUR 22.8M; listed on the ZSE since 16 Nov 2020 — the first domestic ETF. 3) TER 0.90% a year. 4) Returns over the past year: fund +24.6%, index +25.4%; 2024: fund +32.3%, index +33.5%. 5) Composition (July 2026): HT 18.5%, KOEI 18.0%, PODR 16.6%, ADRS2 12.4%, KODT 10.6%, RIVP 10.2%, ATGR 5.2%, HPB 3.5%, ZITO 2.4%, ADPL 1.3% — the top four positions carry ~65% of the fund. 6) ZSE liquidity: traded on 227 of 250 working days. 7) Portfolio indicators: P/E 16.6; constituent dividend yield 2.6%. Note: for each of the 10 constituent stocks the AI Forum runs a separate discussion with a fair-value zone.
